caption:
Begging the storm to stop? His power is for standing in it. (1 Timothy 1:12 devotional)

We keep begging God to stop the storm. But Paul thanks Christ who strengthened him — power isn't the force that ends the rain, it's the strength to stand in it. Grace often doesn't remove the weight; it holds you up under it.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
